Import and Review Members

Upload CSV or Excel (up to 5 MB and 5000 rows). Every name is checked against the master list and saved aliases, including previously imported, historical, and archived members.

Blank cells preserve existing values. Members absent from the file stay unchanged. Existing names stay unchanged when matched; duties, leave, and postings remain linked.

Designation requires an effective-from date. Use Excel dates or YYYY-MM-DD. Separate aliases with semicolons. Resolve uncertain matches or skip rows before applying.
